faqs.question: Why choose Interio by Godrej for your home furniture?
faqs.answer: With over 100 years of Godrej trust and manufacturing excellence in India, Interio by Godrej brings together ergonomic design, sustainable materials, state-of-the-art durability, free doorstep delivery, and expert assembly across 17,000+ pin codes.

faqs.question: How does Godrej Interio Furniture Exchange work?
faqs.answer: You can trade in your old furniture of any brand and receive instant exchange discounts of up to ₹5,000 on your new Godrej Interio order, along with hassle-free doorstep pickup.

faqs.question: Do you offer customization for modular kitchens and wardrobes?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our design experts provide end-to-end 3D visualization, material customization, and on-site measurement consultations. We use 100% rust-free galvanized steel frames and premium soft-close German hardware.

faqs.question: What warranties are offered on Godrej Interio products?
faqs.answer: Godrej Interio provides up to 10 years of structural warranty on steel almirahs and modular kitchens, and comprehensive 1-to-3 year warranties on sofas, solid wood sets, and motorized storage beds.

faqs.question: Is free delivery and professional installation included?
faqs.answer: Yes, all eligible furniture orders include free delivery and white-glove assembly by certified Godrej technicians.

liveFaqs.question: Why should we choose Interio by Godrej for our homes?
liveFaqs.answer: Interio by Godrej brings smart, stylish, and durable home furniture across living, bedroom, dining, and storage solutions—designed to elevate comfort, maximize space, and complement every modern home with 100+ years of trusted engineering.

liveFaqs.question: What is covered in the warranty period, and how can I raise a claim?
liveFaqs.answer: We offer comprehensive warranties ranging up to 10 years on steel structural frames and modular kitchens, and 1 to 3 years on upholstery, motorized mechanisms, and wooden furniture. You can easily raise a claim by calling our toll-free support at 1800-267-1122 or submitting an online service request.

liveFaqs.question: Is there a return or replacement policy?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes, Godrej Interio offers a transparent replacement and return policy. In the unlikely event of transit damage or manufacturing defect, our technician will inspect and arrange a free replacement or prompt resolution.

liveFaqs.question: Which shopping option is right for me - Online or In-Store?
liveFaqs.answer: Shopping online gives you access to the entire 2000+ product catalog with doorstep delivery across 17,000+ PIN codes. Visiting our 1000+ experience centers allows you to test comfort and consult in-person with 3D design experts.

liveFaqs.question: Are the products, prices, and warranty the same online and in-store?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes, Godrej Interio maintains uniform high standards of manufacturing quality, transparent pricing, and nationwide brand warranty whether you order online or visit any of our authorized retail stores.
